summary: A Google DeepMind product lead shares a Gemini Southeast Asia usage report showing active users more than doubled year-over-year, with 70% of prompts in native languages and 40% using only voice, image, or video.

mechanisms.reason: A stated doubling of active users in a specific region indicates rising consumer inference volume, though scoped to Southeast Asia only.
mechanisms.quote: Active users more than doubled in the last year
